1. (Currently Amended) An assembly comprising a test tube with an affixed MTP, wherein the MTP is __a passive RFID tag__ and the test tube is __specifically adapted for biorepository sample storage at cryogenic temperatures__.

2. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in the test tube __such that the MTP remains readable after exposure to temperatures of -20°C or below__.

3. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __with a frost-coated or opaque layer between the MTP and the exterior surface,__ oriented for reading downwards.

4. (Original) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the test tube is a biorepository test tube.

5. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded in __a combination of polypropylene or acetal polymer with a thermally conductive adhesive layer that allows the MTP to be read through the plastic material__.

6. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 1, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

(Currently Amended) A system for storing samples and comprising of the assembly of claim 1, and __at least two of the following: a rack specifically designed for biorepository test tubes with RFID-compatible spacing; an automated robot for moving racks or biorepository test tubes equipped with RFID reading capability; and an automated sampling device adapted to sample said racks or biorepository test tubes and integrated with RFID tracking__.

14. (Currently Amended) The system of claim 13 __wherein the racks/test tubes are maintained and handled at -20°C or less during storage and retrieval operations__.

15. (Currently Amended) A method of forming a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: __heating the MTP to above the melting point of the plastic material; and melting a portion of the plastic with the heated MTP to embed the MTP within the plastic__.

16. (Currently Amended) A method of reading an embedded MTP in a test tube assembly of claim 1, comprising: __positioning the test tube assembly in an RFID reader device; and reading the MTP through the embedded plastic material__.

17. (Original) The method of reading of claim 16, wherein the embedding material is frost coated.

18. (Original) The method of claim 16, wherein the reader comprises a vial receptacle and wherein vial receptacle and the embedded MTP are maintained at a temperature of -20°C or less.

19. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded in __a combination of polypropylene or acetal polymer with enhanced thermal stability for cryogenic storage__.

20. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

21. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 19, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __with a protective coating layer,__ oriented for reading downwards.

22. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded near the center bottom of the __test tube__.

23. (Currently Amended) The assembly of claim 4, wherein the MTP is embedded underneath the bottom of the test tube, __with a protective frost-coated or opaque layer,__ oriented for reading downwards.
